title.en: Does Diesel 40 cover rural and infrastructure work?
title.zh: 柴油40覆盖农村和基建吗？

description.en: The page says yes: no stable grid, rural and infrastructure placement. Cells are 4108 / 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa and 120 m / 360 m, with 1 cm aggregate in the introduction.
description.zh: 产品页写了：电网不便、农村与基建浇筑。格子是 4108 / 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、120 m / 360 m，产品介绍里有 1 cm 骨料。

h1.en: Does Diesel 40 cover rural and infrastructure work?
h1.zh: 柴油40覆盖农村和基建吗？

directAnswer.en: Yes, as those published sentences, inside 120 m / 360 m. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Diesel 40 at 4108 diesel 66 kW, 26 m³/h, 25 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, Kawasaki 112, 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm and 2800 kg. The introduction pairs 120 m / 360 m with 1 cm aggregate. There is no separate maximum-aggregate cell. It is not the 17 kW rural house pump and not the tractor-driven 4100.
directAnswer.zh: 可以，按那些已公布的句子，并且停在 120 m / 360 m 内。邢台河北品锦机械把柴油40印成 4108 柴油机 66 kW、26 m³/h、25 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、川崎 112、外形 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm、2800 kg。产品介绍把 120 m / 360 m 和 1 cm 骨料写在一起。没有单独的最大骨料格。它不是 17 kW 的农村住宅泵，也不是拖拉机带动4100。

heading.en: Rural here is not the compact rural page
heading.zh: 这里的农村不是紧凑农村页

body.en: The compact rural diesel prints 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 30–50 m horizontal, 10–30 m vertical, aggregate 1–3 cm and 800 kg, and its name is the self-built house pump. Diesel 40 is a 2800 kg trailer. Use it when the infrastructure or rural line needs the 26 m³/h and 120 m / 360 m window and the site has no stable grid. A house that fits the 17 kW window should stay there.
body.zh: 紧凑农村柴油泵印的是 17 kW、5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m、骨料 1–3 cm、800 kg，产品名就是自建房泵。柴油40是 2800 kg 的拖泵。基建或农村管路需要 26 m³/h 和 120 m / 360 m、现场又没有稳定电网时，用它。落在 17 kW 窗口里的住宅应留在那一页。

heading.en: On a grid, Electric 40 is the medium-building neighbour
heading.zh: 有电网时，电动40是中型建筑的邻居

body.en: Electric 40 prints 45 kW, 21 m³/h and fine stone 120 m / 360 m. The distance pair looks similar and the output does not: 21 versus 26 m³/h. The selection guide tells you to choose power type first. Do not copy Diesel 40’s 1 cm introduction note onto Electric 40’s fine-stone and aggregate-13 rows.
body.zh: 电动40印的是 45 kW、21 m³/h、细石 120 m / 360 m。距离看起来接近，输送量不是：21 对 26 m³/h。选型指南让你先定动力。不要把柴油40介绍里的 1 cm 抄到电动40的细石行和 13 骨料行上。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say whether the job is the compact 17 kW house or the 66 kW trailer window. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请说明工况是紧凑的 17 kW 住宅，还是 66 kW 拖泵窗口。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: No. The 4100 is a separate tractor-driven page at 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h and 1300 kg.
answer.zh: 不是。4100 是单独的拖拉机带动页：40 kW、6–12 m³/h、1300 kg。

question.en: Does the table print maximum aggregate?

answer.en: No. Only the introduction mentions 1 cm aggregate with the distance.
answer.zh: 没有。只有产品介绍在距离旁边提到 1 cm 骨料。

answer.en: No. The cell is 120 m / 360 m, horizontal / vertical.
answer.zh: 不是。格子是水平/垂直 120 m / 360 m。
